findings.source: Learn indirect control: scout with a flag, supply your colony, and direct an attack.
findings.target: Jifunze kuongoza kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja: chunguza kwa bendera, pelekea makazi lako mahitaji, na ongoza shambulio.
findings.problem: makazi takes collective ma-class/ya- agreement, but makazi lako uses singular li-concord; this contradicts the approved base and other new entries.
findings.suggested_correction: Jifunze kuongoza kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja: chunguza kwa bendera, pelekea makazi yako mahitaji, na ongoza shambulio.
evidence: Kamusi Project dictionary makazi class6, PDFpage443 (zero-based442).
Prior independently accepted Sw native glossary and concord review.

findings.source: Build a Hospital and help a wounded worker recover. The colony starts fed, with one injured worker.
findings.target: Jenga Hospitali na umsaidie mfanyakazi aliyejeruhiwa apone. Makazi yanaanza yakiwa na chakula cha kutosha, na mfanyakazi mmoja aliyejeruhiwa.
findings.problem: The source says the creatures start fed (their hunger satisfied), not merely that the colony has enough food available. That distinction explains why the prepared injured worker needs a Hospital rather than hunger relief. Current chakula cha kutosha changes the starting-state explanation.
findings.suggested_correction: Jenga Hospitali na umsaidie mfanyakazi aliyejeruhiwa apone. Mwanzoni, viumbe wa makazi wameshiba, na mfanyakazi mmoja amejeruhiwa.
evidence: Healing definition binds patient and requires HP recovery; nearby source explicitly says patient already fed.

findings.problem: unakoelekea means where you are heading. The control reveals the current lesson target/marker (including a building, worker or defense area); it does not inspect the player or a selected unit travel destination. Use an objective-location caption.
evidence: Tutorial::ShowDestination callback centers camera on current destination marker; lesson definitions vary destination target.

findings.source: Select the tower and request suppliers. Wait for at least 2 stone. A finished tower needs an operating worker target to bring ammunition. This is separate from its construction target.
findings.target: Chagua mnara na uombe wasambazaji. Subiri angalau mawe 2. Mnara uliokamilika unahitaji lengo la wafanyakazi wa kuuhudumia ili kuleta risasi. Hili ni tofauti na lengo lake la ujenzi.
findings.problem: lengo la wafanyakazi can read as the workers' goal. This procedural explanation needs the requested worker count for operating supply, distinct from the construction count. The earlier introduction explains this precisely; keep that distinction explicit here.
findings.suggested_correction: Chagua mnara na uombe wasambazaji. Subiri angalau mawe 2. Mnara uliokamilika unahitaji uombe wafanyakazi wa kuleta risasi. Idadi hiyo inawekwa tofauti na idadi ya wafanyakazi wa ujenzi.
evidence: Source operating worker target versus construction target; towerReady and loadedTower stages are separate.

findings.source: Open Flags, choose War Flag, and place it over the enemy Swarm east of the stone. Select the flag and request up to 4 warriors. A small radius keeps them concentrated. Leave placement with the secondary mouse button before selecting the flag. If no warriors remain, produce more at the Swarm. Warriors may stop to eat; keep the Inns supplied.
findings.target: Fungua Bendera, chagua Bendera ya vita, na uiweke juu ya Kiota cha adui mashariki mwa mawe. Chagua bendera na uombe hadi mashujaa 4. Nusukipenyo kidogo huwafanya wajikusanye karibu. Toka kwenye hali ya kuweka kwa kitufe cha pili cha kipanya kabla ya kuchagua bendera. Ikiwa hakuna mashujaa waliobaki, zalisha wengine katika Kiota. Mashujaa wanaweza kusimama kula; endelea kupelekea nyumba za wageni mahitaji.
findings.problem: The compound nusukipenyo is attested, but the draft uses ki-concord kidogo while Kamusi labels it9/10; published usage is variable. Do not infer its class solely from embedded kipenyo. Preserve the established term and avoid this unresolved concord through an explicit value construction.
findings.suggested_correction: Fungua Bendera, chagua Bendera ya vita, na uiweke juu ya Kiota cha adui mashariki mwa mawe. Chagua bendera na uombe hadi mashujaa 4. Thamani ndogo ya nusukipenyo huwafanya wajikusanye karibu. Toka kwenye hali ya kuweka kwa kitufe cha pili cha kipanya kabla ya kuchagua bendera. Ikiwa hakuna mashujaa waliobaki, zalisha wengine katika Kiota. Mashujaa wanaweza kusimama kula; endelea kupelekea nyumba za wageni mahitaji.
findings.confidence: medium; variant usage not declared categorically wrong
evidence: Kamusi Project dictionary nusukipenyo class9/10, PDFpage660 (zero-based659).
Mozilla Sw styleguide permits regrouping source syntax for clear idiomatic text.

findings.source: Place a War Flag over the enemy Swarm; request 3 warriors and use radius 4 or smaller. Guard zones and War Flags compete for warriors. Remove guard tiles if they hold your army back. Keep food available while warriors travel and attack.
findings.target: Weka Bendera ya vita juu ya Kiota cha adui; omba mashujaa 3 na utumie nusukipenyo cha 4 au chini. Maeneo ya ulinzi na Bendera za vita hushindania mashujaa. Ondoa miraba ya ulinzi ikiwa inalizuia jeshi lako kusonga. Dumisha chakula wakati mashujaa wanasafiri na kushambulia.
findings.problem: nusukipenyo cha4 assumes ki-class for the compound; dictionary evidence labels9/10 and usage varies. Avoid an unnecessary unresolved concord while retaining numeric limit4 and the established radius term.
findings.suggested_correction: Weka Bendera ya vita juu ya Kiota cha adui; omba mashujaa 3 na uweke nusukipenyo kuwa 4 au chini. Maeneo ya ulinzi na Bendera za vita hushindania mashujaa. Ondoa miraba ya ulinzi ikiwa inalizuia jeshi lako kusonga. Dumisha chakula wakati mashujaa wanasafiri na kushambulia.
findings.confidence: medium; preferred safe rephrase rather than assert one variant ungrammatical

Supply-request versus observed count; constructed versus operating jobs; workforce-only ratios0/1; births consume wheat; automatic training existing units; levels1–3; guard4tiles/2warriors; focusedcounterattack3warriors/radius≤4.
accepted_without_rewrite: Kiota/Viota, Nyumba ya wageni, Kambi ya jeshi, Uwanja wa mbio, Bwawa la kuogelea, Shule match approved control names.
Viumbe animate wa-/a- agreement is retained; no force to inanimate vi-/ki- forms merely because of noun spelling.
Risasi retains existing ammunition glossary; instructions explicitly state tower stone supply.
Harvesting consistently means malighafi collection, not only crop harvest.
Secondary mouse button remains generic to respect input preferences.
No unreviewed English-equal message, placeholder change, missing key or temporary marker found.

references.inspection: Read actual academic appendix: noun classes and animate semantic agreement. Confirms viumbe animate agreement need not follow visible prefix; no fabricated replacements of good wa-/a- concord.
Read software style/tone, glossary consistency, restructuring and concise unambiguous procedural guidance; did not import repository-incompatible legacy syntax prescriptions.

Opened actual Kamusi Project dictionary PDF (third-party host) and located makazi class6 atPDF442 and nusukipenyo class9/10 atPDF659, zero-based pages. Lexical record is evidence, not proof that every contemporary usage rejects another concord. Safe value construction resolves that uncertainty.
Search excerpt attests nusu+kipenyo compound; fullPDF fetch timed out. Not treated as a fully read grammar authority.
